study type: Qualitative exploratory design using focus group discussion
cohort: The study participants were 12 married men between the ages of 45 to 60 years, working as commercial drivers in an urban community in Ghana.
finding: The study revealed that vasectomy was perceived by some respondents to be synonymous with castration, and inadequate knowledge, negative perceptions, future uncertainty, and the irreversible nature of vasectomy contributed to low patronage and intentions not to opt for it.
cross-section timing: Data were collected at a single point in time from the participants through focus group discussions.
